title.en: Jōmon: settled lives before farming
title.zh: 绳文：农业之前的定居生活

location.label: Northern Japan; regional reference point near Aomori

summary.en: People in northern Japan sustained settled communities through hunting, fishing and gathering over many millennia. Their settlements, graves, pottery, figurines and stone circles preserve evidence of domestic life and shared rituals. The Jōmon sites show that farming was not the only route to a settled society. This entry represents a broad archaeological tradition across several places, rather than one kingdom or a single unchanging way of life.
summary.zh: 日本北部的人们在漫长岁月中依靠狩猎、捕鱼和采集维持定居社区。聚落、墓葬、陶器、土偶和石圈留下了日常生活与共同仪式的证据。绳文遗址提醒我们，农业并非定居社会的唯一基础。此处呈现的是分布于多个地点、不断变化的考古文化，而不是一个王国。

dateNote.en: Regional span c. 13,000–400 BCE across 17 northern-Japan sites. Individual sites have different dates. The pin is a regional reference near Aomori; nearby Sannai-Maruyama dates to c. 3900–2200 BCE. It does not represent continuous occupation at one place throughout the full regional interval.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前13000—400年是日本北部17处遗址共同呈现的区域时段，各遗址年代不同。地图点位于青森附近，仅作为区域参照；附近的三内丸山遗址约为公元前3900—2200年。整个区域时段不代表同一地点一直有人居住。

sources.title: Jomon Prehistoric Sites in Northern Japan
sources.evidenceNote: Synthesis dates the represented sedentary hunter-fisher-gatherer tradition to c. 13,000–400 BCE.

sources.title: Sannai Maruyama Site
sources.publisher: World Heritage Jomon Prehistoric Sites in Northern Japan
sources.evidenceNote: The official component-site page dates the Special Historic Site to c. 3900–2200 BCE and locates it in Aomori City; this differs from the regional span represented by the atlas entry.

title.en: Göbekli Tepe: building together
title.zh: 哥贝克力石阵：共同建造

summary.en: Communities in Upper Mesopotamia raised large stone enclosures and carved animals onto T-shaped pillars. The site shows that people could organize monumental construction before pottery became part of everyday life here. The buildings are evidence of collective activity; their precise purposes remain a subject of archaeological interpretation.
summary.zh: 上美索不达米亚的居民建起大型石构建筑，并在T形石柱上雕刻动物。这里表明，在当地陶器尚未成为日常用品时，人们已经能组织大型公共建造活动。遗迹留下了共同活动的证据，但建筑的具体用途仍需考古研究来解释。

dateNote.en: Approximate construction range used by UNESCO, not a dated founding event. The pin marks the archaeological site; it is not a cultural boundary.
dateNote.zh: 采用联合国教科文组织所列的大致建造年代，并非精确建城年份。地图标记为考古遗址，不表示文化疆界。

title.en: Çatalhöyük: life above the rooftops
title.zh: 加泰土丘：屋顶上的聚落

summary.en: At Çatalhöyük, closely packed houses were entered from their roofs instead of ordinary streets. Successive building layers preserve paintings, sculpture and household spaces. These remains let archaeologists investigate how people organized long-term settlement, shared space and maintained traditions across generations.
summary.zh: 加泰土丘的房屋彼此紧邻，居民从屋顶进入家中，而非沿普通街道进门。层层叠加的建筑中保存着壁画、雕塑与家庭生活空间。这些遗迹让考古学家能够研究定居者如何安排共同空间，并在一代代人之间延续生活习俗。

dateNote.en: This entry covers the eastern mound's Neolithic occupation, approximately 7400–6200 BCE. The western mound continued later; the end date is not the end of all settlement.
dateNote.zh: 本条目关注东丘约公元前7400至6200年的新石器时代居住阶段。西丘后来仍有人居住，结束年份不代表整个聚落消失。

title.en: Kuk: independent agricultural development
title.zh: 库克：独立发展的农业

summary.en: At Kuk in the New Guinea highlands, buried traces of mounds and drainage ditches record changing ways of cultivating wetlands. The evidence includes the propagation of crops such as bananas, taro and yams and supports independent agricultural development in this region. Land use has been persistent but episodic rather than unchanged. The long sequence allows learners to compare different agricultural paths and to recognise local knowledge in the management of a difficult environment.
summary.zh: 新几内亚高地的库克遗址中，埋藏的种植土墩和排水沟记录了湿地耕作方式的变化。包括香蕉、芋头和薯蓣等作物的栽培证据，支持这一地区农业独立发展的认识。土地利用长期延续，但也有间歇与变化。它有助于比较不同农业道路，并看见地方知识在环境管理中的作用。

dateNote.en: The rounded start c. 5000 BCE follows the early edge of the 6950–6440 cal BP range for mounded cultivation; BP is anchored to 1950. Land use occurred in phases, including early-20th-century abandonment and renewed settlement around 1960. This focus interval does not imply farming in every year. 2026 is an atlas cutoff, not an end to local traditions.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前5000年的起点取自土墩耕作6950—6440校正距今年范围的较早端，经过取整；BP以1950年为基准。土地利用经历多个阶段，包括20世纪初的离弃与约1960年的重新定居。这一关注时段不表示每一年都在耕作；2026年只是地图截止点，不表示地方传统结束。

sources.title: Kuk Early Agricultural Site
sources.evidenceNote: Synthesis describes c. 7,000–6,400-year crop cultivation, later ditch drainage, and episodic land use continuing to the present.

sources.title: Origins of agriculture at Kuk Swamp in the highlands of New Guinea
sources.evidenceNote: The research abstract dates mounded cultivation and intensive banana cultivation to 6950–6440 calibrated years BP. It distinguishes earlier plant exploitation from this stronger evidence of agriculture.

sources.title: Kuk Phase 7, 1969–1990, the Kuk Research Station: A Colonial Interlude
sources.evidenceNote: The scholarly chapter records Kawelka abandonment of Kuk in the early 20th century, absence of inhabitants in 1933, and gradual return from about 1960; a broad focus interval must not imply unbroken occupation or farming.

title.en: Budj Bim: Gunditjmara aquaculture
title.zh: 布吉必姆：贡第杰马拉人的水产系统

location.label: Budj Bim / Tae Rak cultural landscape

summary.en: Gunditjmara communities used the Budj Bim lava landscape to build and maintain channels, weirs and ponds for trapping, holding and harvesting kooyang, or short-finned eel. Dated channels and later walls reveal construction in several phases. Water, stone, seasonal animal movement and community knowledge shaped this system. The landscape remains connected to living Gunditjmara traditions and responsibilities, showing that managed food production includes much more than fields of crops.
summary.zh: 贡第杰马拉人在布吉必姆熔岩地貌上建造、维护水渠、堰坝与池塘，用于捕捉、暂养和收获短鳍鳗。水渠与后加石墙的测年显示，系统经历了多个建设阶段。水流、石材、动物季节性活动与社区知识共同塑造了这一体系。这里仍与贡第杰马拉人的生活传统和责任相连，说明人类管理的食物生产远不止农田种植。

dateNote.en: The approximate start, c. 4650 BCE, refers to an early dated channel at least 6600 calibrated years BP; BP is anchored to 1950, not the current year. It does not date the whole network or the beginning of Gunditjmara culture. Construction and use had several phases. 2026 is an atlas cutoff for living traditions, not a cultural end date.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前4650年的起点依据一段早期水渠至少6600校正距今年的测年；BP以1950年为基准，并非今天。这个日期不代表整个水渠网络同时建成，也不是贡第杰马拉文化的起点。建设与使用经历多个阶段；2026年只是地图截止点，不表示生活传统结束。

sources.title: Budj Bim Cultural Landscape
sources.evidenceNote: Synthesis describes at least 6,600 years of constructed aquaculture and continuing Gunditjmara knowledge and practice.

sources.title: Phased redevelopment of an ancient Gunditjmara fish trap over the past 800 years
sources.evidenceNote: The research abstract gives early channel construction at least 6600 cal BP and later basalt block walls around 600–800 cal BP. The atlas uses a rounded civil-year anchor of c. 4650 BCE and treats the network as phased.

sources.title: The detective work behind the Budj Bim eel traps World Heritage bid
sources.evidenceNote: The excavating archaeologist distinguishes an early dated channel from a much later dam wall and describes continuing Gunditjmara relationships with the cultural landscape.

title.en: Uruk: cities and written accounts
title.zh: 乌鲁克：城市与文字记账

summary.en: By about 3200 BCE, Uruk had become a large city with monumental mud-brick buildings and specialized art. People used signs on clay tablets to record goods and workers' rations. Those administrative experiments helped develop the writing traditions that later became cuneiform, connecting urban growth with new ways to store information.
summary.zh: 到约公元前3200年，乌鲁克已成为拥有大型泥砖建筑与专门艺术生产的城市。人们在泥板上画出符号，记录物品和劳动者的口粮。这些管理活动推动了后来楔形文字传统的发展，使城市成长与保存信息的新方法联系起来。

dateNote.en: An approximate focus on late fourth-millennium urban and recording practices. Uruk continued after this interval; it does not mark the city's complete lifespan.
dateNote.zh: 这里选取公元前第四千纪晚期的城市与记账发展阶段。乌鲁克在此后仍然延续，时间范围并非这座城市的完整寿命。

title.en: Liangzhu: rice, water and an early city
title.zh: 良渚：稻作、水利与早期城市

summary.en: Liangzhu brings together a city, dams and burial grounds in the Yangtze River region. Rice cultivation supported a society that built large earthen works and managed water across its landscape. Differences among burials provide evidence of social hierarchy and shared beliefs. Reading these remains together helps explain how food production, infrastructure and political organisation could develop as connected parts of early urban life.
summary.zh: 良渚将城市、水坝与墓地连成一幅长江流域早期社会的图景。稻作农业支撑着大型土筑工程和跨越周边地区的水利系统。墓葬之间的差异反映社会等级，共同的礼仪器物则帮助人们理解当时的信仰。把这些遗迹放在一起观察，可以看到粮食生产、基础设施与政治组织之间的联系。

dateNote.en: Approximate archaeological date range, 3300–2300 BCE; these are not exact founding and abandonment years.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前3300—2300年为考古年代范围，并非精确的建城与废弃年份。

sources.title: Archaeological Ruins of Liangzhu City
sources.evidenceNote: UNESCO describes c. 3300–2300 BCE, rice cultivation, dams, urban planning and differentiated burials.

title.en: Caral: an early Andean city
title.zh: 卡拉尔：早期安第斯城市

summary.en: Caral's builders organized platform mounds, sunken courts and residential spaces in Peru's Supe Valley. The city belonged to a wider group of settlements, making it a useful place to explore how collective construction and social organization developed in the Andes. Its buildings preserve evidence of an early urban society with ceremonial spaces and a planned arrangement of public and residential areas.
summary.zh: 卡拉尔的建造者在秘鲁苏佩河谷安排了台基、下沉庭院与居住空间。这座城市属于更广泛的聚落群，帮助我们理解安第斯地区的共同建造和社会组织如何发展。建筑保存了早期城市社会的证据，包括仪式空间，以及有规划的公共区域与居住区。

dateNote.en: Approximate 3000–1800 BCE development range from the radiocarbon synthesis on UNESCO's page. Archaeological chronologies vary with the phase and material being dated.
dateNote.zh: 采用联合国教科文组织页面中放射性碳测年综述给出的约公元前3000至1800年范围。不同遗址阶段和测年材料会产生不同的年代判断。

title.en: Dholavira: a city shaped by scarce water
title.zh: 多拉维拉：缺水环境中的城市

summary.en: Dholavira’s inhabitants built an urban settlement on an arid island, using seasonal streams within a planned water-management system. Its fortifications, streets, houses and cemetery show different aspects of social organisation. Workshops and objects made from shell, stone and metal also preserve evidence of skilled production and connections with other regions. The site links the history of cities to a practical question: how can a community organise life around a limited water supply?
summary.zh: 多拉维拉居民在干旱岛屿上建城，把季节性河流纳入水利系统。城防、街道、房屋与墓地呈现社会组织的不同侧面。工坊以及贝壳、石料和金属制品，也留下专业生产与跨地区联系的证据。这处遗址把城市史与一个实际问题联系起来：人们如何围绕有限的水源组织生活？

dateNote.en: Approximate occupation span, 3000–1500 BCE; different urban phases occurred within it.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前3000—1500年为居住年代范围，其中包含不同城市发展阶段。

sources.title: Dholavira: a Harappan City
sources.evidenceNote: Source gives c. 3000–1500 BCE occupation, water systems, workshops, cemetery and interregional trade.

title.en: Memphis and Egypt's pyramid builders
title.zh: 孟菲斯与埃及金字塔建造者

location.label: Memphis and the nearby necropolis, Nile valley

summary.en: Memphis was an administrative and religious centre of Egypt's Old Kingdom. Nearby cemeteries preserve the development from earlier tomb forms to large stone pyramids. Royal monuments, officials' tombs and workshop remains reveal both state organization and changing artistic practices. Much of the surviving evidence comes from burial contexts, so it gives an uneven picture of everyday life.
summary.zh: 孟菲斯是埃及古王国时期的行政与宗教中心。附近墓地保存了早期墓葬向大型石质金字塔发展的证据。王室纪念建筑、官员墓葬和工坊遗迹展现了国家组织与艺术变化。但现存材料多与丧葬有关，不能完整反映普通人的日常生活。

dateNote.en: Approximate Old Kingdom chronology follows the Met's 2649–2130 BCE convention; other chronologies differ. The representative pin marks Memphis, not every pyramid.
dateNote.zh: 年代采用大都会艺术博物馆约公元前2649至2130年的古王国分期，不同研究的年代划分可能不同。标记代表孟菲斯，不是所有金字塔的位置。

sources.title: Egypt in the Old Kingdom (ca. 2649–2130 B.C.)

title.en: Mohenjo-daro: planning urban life
title.zh: 摩亨佐达罗：规划城市生活

summary.en: Mohenjo-daro’s streets, wells, drains and public bathing structures preserve evidence of an organised urban settlement in the Indus region. Its higher western area and lower town show different arrangements within the city. These remains direct attention to water, sanitation and everyday movement as well as monumental buildings. The surviving archaeological evidence supports questions about civic organisation; it does not by itself identify a named ruler or explain every institution.
summary.zh: 摩亨佐达罗的街道、水井、排水设施和公共浴场留下了印度河流域城市组织的证据。西部高地与下城呈现不同的空间布局。除了大型建筑，这些遗迹也让人关注供水、卫生与日常通行。考古证据可以帮助讨论城市管理，却不能仅凭遗址就确定某位统治者或解释全部制度。

dateNote.en: Approximate urban flourishing, c. 2600–1900 BCE, corroborated by archaeologist Jonathan Mark Kenoyer’s site overview; not exact foundation or abandonment dates.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前2600—1900年的城市繁盛阶段，由考古学家乔纳森·马克·肯诺耶的遗址介绍核实；不是精确建城或废弃年份。

sources.title: Archaeological Ruins at Moenjodaro
sources.evidenceNote: The UNESCO source supports the Indus city context, town planning, drains and wells. Its broad chronology is supplemented by Kenoyer’s site overview.

sources.title: Mohenjo-daro!
sources.evidenceNote: The opened archaeologist-led site overview dates the city’s flourishing to 2600–1900 BCE and documents its streets, wells and drains.

title.en: Akkad: joining city-states by conquest
title.zh: 阿卡德：征服连接城邦

location.label: Central Mesopotamia, regional reference near Kish

summary.en: Sargon and his successors brought rival southern Mesopotamian cities under a ruling dynasty associated with Akkad. Royal campaigns carried their ambitions beyond Sumer, while seals and monuments presented new images of kingship. The capital itself has not been securely located, reminding us that a well-known empire can remain archaeologically uneven. Naram-Sin’s reign represents a phase of considerable expansion, not a border that remained constant throughout the dynasty. The transition from competing cities to wider rule provides an early case for studying conquest, political integration and the ways rulers represented their own authority.
summary.zh: 萨尔贡及其继承者将南美索不达米亚的竞争城邦纳入阿卡德王朝。战争把其势力伸向苏美尔之外，印章与纪念物也塑造新的王权形象。阿卡德都城尚未确定位址，提醒我们即使著名帝国也存在考古空白。纳拉姆辛时期的扩张并不意味着疆界始终相同；从城邦竞争到广域统治，可用来研究征服、整合与王权表达。

dateNote.en: c. 2350–2150 BCE is the source’s approximate period. The marker is regional; the city of Akkad remains unlocated.
dateNote.zh: 约前2350—2150年采用来源时段；标记只是区域参照，阿卡德城址尚未确定。

sources.title: The Akkadian Period (ca. 2350–2150 B.C.)
sources.evidenceNote: c. 2350–2150 BCE is the source’s approximate period. The marker is regional; the city of Akkad remains unlocated.

title.en: Old Babylon: Hammurabi’s expanding kingdom
title.zh: 古巴比伦：汉谟拉比的王国

summary.en: Babylon became a major political centre under Hammurabi, who combined alliances with military campaigns to bring a large territory under his authority. His celebrated law monument placed royal justice in public view, but its rules also distinguished people by social status. Successors maintained the dynasty until a Hittite attack reached Babylon. This story connects the practical work of coalition-building and conquest with the ideals kings wanted to project. Babylon’s later prestige sometimes obscures these earlier circumstances: it was a city whose importance was made and remade, not an eternal capital of one continuous empire.
summary.zh: 汉谟拉比通过联盟与战争扩大统治，使巴比伦成为重要政治中心。著名法典碑将王室正义公开呈现，但条文也区分社会身份。其继承者延续王朝，直至赫梯进攻巴比伦。这里可以同时考察结盟、征服的实际政治与君主宣扬的理想。巴比伦后来的声望容易掩盖早期处境：它的重要性被多次重建，并非一个帝国永恒不变的首都。

dateNote.en: 1792 BCE starts Hammurabi’s reign in the middle chronology; 1595 BCE marks the Hittite sack. This is a selected royal period.
dateNote.zh: 前1792年采用中年表的汉谟拉比即位年；前1595年为赫梯攻城。此处为选定王朝阶段。

sources.title: Babylon
sources.evidenceNote: 1792 BCE starts Hammurabi’s reign in the middle chronology; 1595 BCE marks the Hittite sack. This is a selected royal period.

title.en: Poverty Point: building without an agricultural state
title.zh: 波弗蒂角：采集社会的大型工程

summary.en: Hunter-fisher-gatherer communities constructed a vast complex of mounds, ridges and a plaza in the lower Mississippi Valley. Objects from distant places connect Poverty Point with exchange networks extending hundreds of miles. Its scale challenges the assumption that monumental construction always required a farming kingdom or centralized state. Seasonal gatherings and long-term occupation both contributed to the settlement’s life, but its builders’ language, political arrangements and religious meanings remain incompletely understood. Archaeology makes their achievements visible while also defining the limits of what can responsibly be inferred from earthworks and the objects left behind.
summary.zh: 密西西比河下游的狩猎、捕鱼与采集社会，建造大型土丘、环状土垄和广场。远方物品显示交流网络延伸数百英里，工程规模挑战了“大型建筑必需农业王国或中央集权”的想法。季节性聚会和长期居住共同塑造遗址，但建造者的语言、政治组织与宗教含义仍未充分了解。考古既揭示其成就，也说明仅凭土方与器物可以推断到何种程度。

dateNote.en: Approximately 1700–1100 BCE follows the National Park Service’s occupation range; the modern name comes from a later plantation.
dateNote.zh: 约前1700—1100年采用美国国家公园管理局年代；今名来自后来的种植园。

sources.title: Monumental Earthworks of Poverty Point: World Heritage Site
sources.evidenceNote: Approximately 1700–1100 BCE follows the National Park Service’s occupation range; the modern name comes from a later plantation.

title.en: Hittites: a capital on the Anatolian plateau
title.zh: 赫梯：安纳托利亚高原上的都城

summary.en: Hattusha’s walls, temples and royal buildings preserve the centre of a kingdom whose influence reached across Anatolia and into northern Syria. Monumental gateways and the rock sanctuary at Yazılıkaya made religion and political authority visible in the landscape. The city’s position also places it within a wider world of competing Bronze Age powers rather than at the edge of a single Mesopotamian story. Its surviving buildings are evidence for organization, labor and ritual. The later end of the capital’s imperial role should be distinguished from the continuing histories of communities and successor kingdoms in the region.
summary.zh: 哈图沙的城墙、神庙和王宫保存了一个影响安纳托利亚与叙利亚北部的王国中心。宏伟城门与雅兹勒卡亚石刻圣所将宗教和政治权威融入地景。它属于多个青铜时代强国竞争的世界，不能仅视为美索不达米亚历史的边缘。建筑体现组织、劳动和仪式；都城帝国地位的终结，也应与当地社区及后继王国的延续区分。

dateNote.en: c. 1600–1200 BCE is a rounded focus on Hattusha’s imperial-capital period, within UNESCO’s second-millennium context.
dateNote.zh: 约前1600—1200年为哈图沙帝国都城阶段的取整范围，属于来源所述前二千纪背景。

sources.title: Hattusha: the Hittite Capital
sources.evidenceNote: c. 1600–1200 BCE is a rounded focus on Hattusha’s imperial-capital period, within UNESCO’s second-millennium context.

title.en: New Kingdom Egypt: empire along the Nile
title.zh: 埃及新王国：尼罗河沿线的帝国

summary.en: Ahmose’s reunification opened a period in which Egyptian rulers extended military power into Nubia and the eastern Mediterranean. Wealth supported temples, royal tombs and the cult of Amun at Thebes. The workers who built and decorated tombs also left evidence of their own community at Deir el-Medina, offering perspectives beyond kings and monuments. Royal power, religious institutions and skilled labor were closely connected. Different rulers pursued different policies, and capitals shifted. The New Kingdom therefore offers both an imperial story and unusually rich material for studying households, craft knowledge and the organization of work.
summary.zh: 雅赫摩斯重新统一后，埃及将军事实力伸向努比亚与地中海东部，财富支持神庙、王陵和底比斯阿蒙神崇拜。建造并装饰陵墓的工匠在德尔麦地那留下社区生活证据，为君王与纪念物之外提供视角。王权、宗教与技术劳动紧密相连，但各王政策不同，都城也有迁移。新王国既是帝国史，也是研究家庭、工艺知识与劳动组织的重要窗口。

dateNote.en: c. 1550–1070 BCE follows the Met chronology. Thebes remained a religious centre even when administrative capitals moved.
dateNote.zh: 约前1550—1070年采用大都会博物馆年表；行政都城迁移后，底比斯仍是宗教中心。

sources.title: Egypt in the New Kingdom (ca. 1550–1070 B.C.)
sources.evidenceNote: c. 1550–1070 BCE follows the Met chronology. Thebes remained a religious centre even when administrative capitals moved.

title.en: Lapita voyagers enter Remote Oceania
title.zh: 拉皮塔航海者进入远大洋洲

summary.en: Communities associated with distinctive Lapita pottery expanded from the Bismarck Archipelago into previously uninhabited parts of Remote Oceania. Skilled voyaging connected settlements across long stretches of ocean, eventually reaching Fiji, Tonga and Samoa. Pottery designs, tools and settlement remains help archaeologists reconstruct these connections, although a shared material style should not be mistaken for a single centralized state. Migrants adapted their food production and fishing to different islands, and human arrival changed local environments. The Pacific appears here as a network created by navigators and communities, with water enabling connections as well as separating places.
summary.zh: 以独特拉皮塔陶器为标志的社会，从俾斯麦群岛扩展到远大洋洲此前无人居住的地区。精熟航海跨越辽阔海面连接聚落，最终到达斐济、汤加和萨摩亚。陶器图案、工具与遗址帮助重建联系，但共同物质风格不等于统一国家。迁徙者因岛屿条件调整种植与捕鱼，人类到来也改变当地环境。太平洋既由海水分隔，也通过航海知识成为相连的世界。

dateNote.en: Approximately 1500–800 BCE covers emergence in the Bismarcks and the early spread to Fiji and western Polynesia; dates vary by site.
dateNote.zh: 约前1500—800年指俾斯麦地区出现及早期扩散至斐济和西波利尼西亚；具体遗址年代不同。

sources.title: Into Remote Oceania: Lapita people
sources.publisher: Te Ara Encyclopedia of New Zealand / Manatū Taonga
sources.evidenceNote: Approximately 1500–800 BCE covers emergence in the Bismarcks and the early spread to Fiji and western Polynesia; dates vary by site.

title.en: Yin Xu: bronze work and written questions
title.zh: 殷墟：青铜工艺与甲骨上的问题

summary.en: At the late Shang capital near Anyang, royal buildings, tombs and bronze objects reveal specialised craft production and royal power. Inscriptions on oracle bones record questions connected with divination and preserve evidence of an early Chinese writing system. The intact tomb of Fu Hao adds another view of elite life. The site allows material objects and written evidence to be considered together, while many details of ordinary life remain less visible.
summary.zh: 安阳附近的晚商都城保留了宫殿、墓葬与青铜器，展现专业工艺与王权组织。甲骨上的占卜文字记录了当时人们提出的问题，也是早期汉字的重要证据。保存完整的妇好墓提供了另一种观察贵族生活的角度。遗物与文字能够相互参照，但普通人的许多生活细节仍然难以看见。

dateNote.en: 1300–1046 BCE is UNESCO’s date range for this late Shang capital, not the whole Shang period.
dateNote.zh: 公元前1300—1046年是该晚商都城的年代范围，不代表整个商代。

sources.title: Yin Xu
sources.evidenceNote: Description identifies late Shang capital, 1300–1046 BCE, bronze craftsmanship, Fu Hao tomb and oracle inscriptions.

title.en: Olmec centres and the movement of precious materials
title.zh: 奥尔梅克中心与珍贵材料流动

summary.en: Communities along Mexico’s Gulf Coast built monumental centres and developed influential artistic traditions now grouped under the name Olmec. Colossal basalt heads and carefully worked greenstone required both specialized skills and access to materials from distant places. San Lorenzo and later La Venta show changing centres of construction and ritual activity. Similar forms circulated widely, but shared images do not prove that one empire controlled every place where they appear. With few decipherable written records, archaeology must connect objects, landscapes and context. The result is a history of creativity and organized labor that also preserves uncertainty about individual rulers and beliefs.
summary.zh: 墨西哥湾岸社会建造大型中心，发展后来统称为奥尔梅克的艺术传统。巨型玄武岩头像与精工绿石器，依赖专业技艺和远方材料。圣洛伦索及后来的拉文塔显示工程和仪式中心不断转移。相似图像广泛流传，却不能证明一个帝国控制所有出现地。在文字证据有限的情况下，考古连接器物、地景与背景，呈现创造力和组织劳动，同时保留对统治者及信仰的不确定性。

dateNote.en: Approximately 1200–400 BCE describes the artistic florescence used by the Met; earlier settlements and later regional traditions extend beyond it.
dateNote.zh: 约前1200—400年为博物馆采用的艺术繁盛期，早期聚落与后续传统超出此范围。

sources.title: Olmec Art
sources.evidenceNote: Approximately 1200–400 BCE describes the artistic florescence used by the Met; earlier settlements and later regional traditions extend beyond it.

title.en: Zhou: kings, lineages and competing states
title.zh: 周：王权、宗族与列国

summary.en: The Zhou replaced Shang rule and governed through relationships with aristocratic lineages. Bronze vessels recorded gifts, offices and ancestral claims, making ritual objects evidence of political authority. After the royal court moved east, regional rulers increasingly acted independently. Competition among these states changed warfare, administration and intellectual life. The long Zhou interval therefore contains very different political worlds: an early royal order and later fragmentation. Reading its objects alongside its chronology helps distinguish a dynasty’s continuing name from its changing ability to command other rulers.
summary.zh: 周取代商后，通过与贵族宗族的关系组织统治。青铜器铭文记录赏赐、官职和祖先功绩，礼器也因此成为政治权力的证据。王室东迁后，地方诸侯日益独立，列国竞争推动战争、行政与思想变化。漫长的周代包含早期王权与后期分裂等不同局面；王朝名称的延续，并不意味着控制力始终相同。

dateNote.en: Uses the Met’s conventional 1046–256 BCE dynastic dates; the Western Zhou ended in 771 BCE. The pin represents the early capital region.
dateNote.zh: 采用大都会博物馆所列公元前1046—256年；西周结束于前771年。标记代表早期都城地区。

sources.title: Shang and Zhou Dynasties: The Bronze Age of China
sources.evidenceNote: Uses the Met’s conventional 1046–256 BCE dynastic dates; the Western Zhou ended in 771 BCE. The pin represents the early capital region.

title.en: Teouma: community life among Lapita settlers
title.zh: 特奥马：拉皮塔定居者的社区生活

summary.en: Teouma’s cemetery on Efate offers a close view of communities formed during Lapita settlement of Vanuatu. Archaeological study reveals elaborate sequences of burial and later handling of remains, with variation between individuals rather than one identical ritual. Isotope evidence suggests that some people grew up locally while others probably arrived from elsewhere, connecting settlement history with actual lives. Diet and the movement of people can therefore be studied alongside pottery and voyaging. Radiocarbon estimates require care because marine foods affect the dating of human bone. This site complements the wider Lapita migration story by examining relationships, ritual practice and community formation.
summary.zh: 埃法特岛特奥马墓地，为理解拉皮塔人定居瓦努阿图时形成的社区提供近距离线索。考古研究揭示复杂的初葬与后续遗骸处理，不同个体之间也存在差异。同位素证据显示，一些人在当地成长，另一些可能来自外地，使迁徙史与具体人生相联系。研究者因此可将饮食、人口流动与陶器和航海一同考察。海洋食物会影响人骨放射性碳测年，解释年代需谨慎。本条目聚焦人际关系、仪式与社区形成，补充较宏观的拉皮塔迁徙故事。

dateNote.en: c.1000–750 BCE is a rounded display window for regular cemetery use, based on published c.2940–2880 to c.2770–2710 calibrated BP estimates (BP reference: 1950). Possible earlier burials remain uncertain.
dateNote.zh: 约前1000—750年为墓地经常使用阶段的取整显示窗口，依据研究所列约距今2940—2880至2770—2710个校正年；BP基准为1950年。可能更早的墓葬仍有不确定性。

sources.title: Radiocarbon dating of burials from the Teouma Lapita cemetery, Efate, Vanuatu
sources.publisher: Australian National University research portal; Petchey et al., Journal of Archaeological Science (2014)
sources.evidenceNote: Research abstract gives regular use by c.2940–2880 calibrated BP and last interments c.2770–2710 calibrated BP; the record rounds this to c.1000–750 BCE. BP is relative to 1950, not the browsing year. Possible earlier use is explicitly uncertain.

sources.title: Lapita burial practices: evidence for complex body and bone treatment at the Teouma cemetery
sources.publisher: Australian National University research portal; Valentin et al., Journal of Island and Coastal Archaeology (2010)
sources.evidenceNote: Original research identifies multi-stage burial practices and variation among mortuary contexts. Interpretations of status and individual choice are possibilities rather than established explanations.

sources.title: Lapita migrants in the Pacific’s oldest cemetery: isotopic analysis at Teouma, Vanuatu
sources.publisher: Australian National University research portal; Bentley et al., American Antiquity (2007)

title.en: Assyria: power displayed in stone
title.zh: 亚述：刻在石上的帝国权力

summary.en: Neo-Assyrian kings expanded through repeated campaigns, collecting tribute and moving conquered populations. Successive capitals, including Nimrud and Nineveh, expressed royal ambitions through monumental architecture. Palace reliefs recorded battles, hunts and processions, presenting the king as victorious and divinely supported. Such images are valuable evidence but also deliberate political messages. Reading them alongside other texts helps recover experiences hidden by royal triumph. Assyrian power linked distant regions while imposing violence and obligations on them. The empire’s final collapse did not erase the people, languages or cultural traditions that had existed within it.
summary.zh: 新亚述诸王通过连续战争扩张，征收贡赋并迁移被征服人口。尼姆鲁德、尼尼微等都城以宏大建筑展示王权，宫殿浮雕则表现战事、狩猎和仪仗，将国王塑造成受神支持的胜利者。这些图像既是证据，也是政治宣传。与其他文献对读，有助于理解凯旋叙事所遮蔽的经历；帝国崩溃也不等于其中的人民、语言和传统消失。

dateNote.en: 911–609 BCE is the conventional Neo-Assyrian political frame. The source treats the longer Assyrian history; Nineveh was only a later capital.
dateNote.zh: 前911—609年为通常采用的新亚述时段；来源也讨论更早亚述史，尼尼微只是后期都城。

sources.title: Assyria, 1365–609 B.C.
sources.evidenceNote: 911–609 BCE is the conventional Neo-Assyrian political frame. The source treats the longer Assyrian history; Nineveh was only a later capital.

title.en: Carthage: a North African maritime power
title.zh: 迦太基：北非海上强权

summary.en: Carthage developed from an earlier settlement into a major Mediterranean trading power. Its location on the Gulf of Tunis connected North Africa with islands, ports and rival states across the sea. Commercial reach depended on political and military relationships as well as ships and goods. The Punic Wars placed Carthage in prolonged conflict with Rome, ending in the city’s destruction in 146 BCE. A Roman city later rose on the site. This layered history makes Carthage a useful place to distinguish a city, a trading network, an imperial state and the successive communities that occupied the same landscape.
summary.zh: 迦太基由早期聚落发展为地中海贸易强权，突尼斯湾的位置连接北非、岛屿和各地港口。商业影响不仅依靠船只与货物，也依靠政治和军事关系。布匿战争使其长期与罗马冲突，最终于前146年遭毁；后来罗马城市又在原址兴起。这里适合区分城市、贸易网络、帝国国家，以及先后生活于同一地景的不同社区。

dateNote.en: c. 600–146 BCE focuses on the trading-power phase; the city’s foundation belongs to the ninth century BCE.
dateNote.zh: 约前600—146年关注贸易强权阶段；建城则在公元前九世纪。

sources.title: Archaeological Site of Carthage
sources.evidenceNote: c. 600–146 BCE focuses on the trading-power phase; the city’s foundation belongs to the ninth century BCE.

title.en: Tikal: a Maya city in a forest landscape
title.zh: 蒂卡尔：森林景观中的玛雅城市

summary.en: Tikal brought together temples, palaces, plazas, roads and many residential areas within a Maya urban landscape. Its monumental centre and surrounding settlements reveal the scale of city life in the lowlands. Changes around the ninth century transformed this urban system. Maya peoples continue to sustain communities and living traditions across the region and beyond.
summary.zh: 蒂卡尔的玛雅城市景观包含神庙、宫殿、广场、道路与大量居住区。纪念性中心和周围聚落展现了低地城市生活的规模。九世纪前后的变化改变了这里的城市体系。玛雅人继续在这一地区及更远的地方维系社群与活态传统。

dateNote.en: Approximate sixth-century BCE origins to urban decline around 900 CE, following UNESCO's synthesis. This is a city phase, not a single lifespan for Maya civilization.
dateNote.zh: 依据联合国教科文组织综述，大致从公元前六世纪延伸到公元900年前后的城市衰落。这是城市分期，并非整个玛雅文明的存续范围。

sources.title: Living Maya Time — Teacher Guide
sources.publisher: Smithsonian National Museum of the American Indian

title.en: Achaemenid Empire: ruling across regions
title.zh: 阿契美尼德帝国：跨地区治理

location.label: Fars, a representative Achaemenid heartland location

summary.en: Cyrus's victories began an imperial expansion that linked parts of western Asia, Egypt and Central Asia. Under Darius, governors and communication routes helped organize the realm. Royal buildings at Susa and Persepolis presented images of peoples bringing tribute. Those images express the court's ideal of authority; they are one kind of evidence, alongside records of conquest and resistance.
summary.zh: 居鲁士的军事胜利开启了帝国扩展，把西亚、埃及与中亚的部分地区联系起来。大流士时期的总督与通信路线帮助组织统治。苏萨和波斯波利斯的王室建筑呈现了各地人民进贡的图像。这些图像表达的是宫廷理想中的权威，需要与征服和反抗的记录一起阅读。

dateNote.en: Conventional 550–330 BCE imperial frame. Territory changed through time. The marker represents the Persian heartland and does not imply a fixed capital or mapped boundary.
dateNote.zh: 采用常见的公元前550至330年帝国分期，疆域在此期间不断变化。标记代表波斯核心地区，不表示固定首都或疆界。

title.en: Persepolis: a royal meeting place
title.zh: 波斯波利斯：王室与多地工艺

summary.en: The Achaemenid rulers built palaces and ceremonial spaces on a large terrace at Persepolis. The architecture combined techniques and artistic traditions from several parts of their empire. Its stairway reliefs and surviving buildings offer a way to study how rulers presented authority and the diversity of the lands they governed.
summary.zh: 阿契美尼德统治者在波斯波利斯的大型台地上修建宫殿与礼仪空间。建筑融合了帝国内多个地区的技术与艺术传统。台阶浮雕及现存建筑帮助我们理解，统治者如何展示权力，并呈现所统治地区的多样性。

dateNote.en: From the conventional foundation date to the destruction of the palace complex in Alexander's campaign. This is the palace's Achaemenid phase, not the whole history of Iran.
dateNote.zh: 采用传统的始建年份与亚历山大征战中宫殿遭破坏的年份，范围限于阿契美尼德王朝阶段，并非伊朗历史的起止。

title.en: Rome: expansion and the republic’s crisis
title.zh: 罗马：扩张与共和危机

summary.en: Rome’s republic combined magistrates, a senate and citizen assemblies, while struggles over status reshaped access to political power. Conquest and diplomacy created an extensive Mediterranean empire long before emperors ruled it. Provincial wealth enriched some Romans, but military demands and growing inequality intensified conflict. Civil wars and the dictatorship of Julius Caesar exposed the limits of republican institutions under these pressures. Octavian’s victory and his adoption of the title Augustus marked a new political settlement. The republic therefore illustrates how overseas expansion could transform the social foundations of government at home.
summary.zh: 罗马共和国结合官职、元老院与公民大会，身份斗争不断改变参与政治的资格。皇帝出现之前，征服与外交已经建立广阔的地中海帝国。行省财富使部分罗马人富裕，军事负担与不平等却加剧冲突。内战和凯撒独裁暴露共和制度面对这些压力的局限。屋大维胜利并获得奥古斯都称号后，形成新的政治安排；海外扩张也深刻改变了本土社会。

dateNote.en: 509 BCE is the traditional foundation date; 27 BCE marks Octavian’s title Augustus, a conventional transition to imperial rule.
dateNote.zh: 前509年为传统建国年代；前27年屋大维获奥古斯都称号，通常作为帝制开端。

sources.title: The Roman Republic
sources.evidenceNote: 509 BCE is the traditional foundation date; 27 BCE marks Octavian’s title Augustus, a conventional transition to imperial rule.

title.en: Athens: art in the civic landscape
title.zh: 雅典：城邦空间中的艺术

summary.en: In the later fifth century BCE, Athens rebuilt the Acropolis with temples and monumental entrances. The project brought architecture, sculpture, religious practice and civic power together. The surviving buildings give a material starting point for studying classical Athens, while the city's political history needs to be understood beyond the monuments alone.
summary.zh: 公元前五世纪后半叶，雅典在卫城修建神庙与宏大的入口建筑。这项工程把建筑、雕塑、宗教活动与城邦权力结合起来。现存建筑为认识古典雅典提供了具体线索，但理解这座城市的政治生活，还需要超越纪念建筑本身。

dateNote.en: Approximate focus on the second half of the fifth century BCE, not the complete duration of Athenian democracy or Greek civilization.
dateNote.zh: 大致选取公元前五世纪后半叶，不代表雅典民主制度或希腊文明的全部持续时间。

title.en: After Alexander: a world of competing kingdoms
title.zh: 亚历山大之后：诸王国的世界

summary.en: After Alexander’s death, his generals and their successors divided his conquests into rival kingdoms. The Antigonids, Seleucids and Ptolemies governed different societies, while some Greek cities organized leagues to protect their independence. Courts supported monumental art, libraries and luxury production; mobile craftspeople and merchants carried techniques between regions. Greek cultural forms spread through unequal encounters with older local traditions, producing varied societies rather than a single uniform civilization. Roman expansion gradually absorbed these kingdoms. Pella marks the Macedonian connection, while the history itself extended across the eastern Mediterranean and deep into Asia.
summary.zh: 亚历山大去世后，将领及其继承者把征服地区分为竞争的王国。安提柯、塞琉古和托勒密王朝治理不同社会，部分希腊城邦则通过联盟维护独立。宫廷支持大型艺术、图书馆与奢侈品制作，工匠和商人流动传播技术。希腊文化与更古老的地方传统在不平等接触中融合，形成多样社会，并非统一文明。罗马逐渐兼并这些国家；佩拉仅代表马其顿起点。

dateNote.en: 323–31 BCE follows the Met’s period convention, ending at Actium; Egypt’s formal annexation followed in 30 BCE.
dateNote.zh: 前323—31年采用博物馆分期，以亚克兴海战为末；埃及正式并入罗马在前30年。

sources.title: Art of the Hellenistic Age and the Hellenistic Tradition
sources.evidenceNote: 323–31 BCE follows the Met’s period convention, ending at Actium; Egypt’s formal annexation followed in 30 BCE.

title.en: Maurya: empire and public inscriptions
title.zh: 孔雀王朝：帝国与公开铭文

summary.en: Chandragupta Maurya built a large state centred on Pataliputra, and his successors extended its authority across much of the subcontinent. Ashoka’s inscriptions made royal messages visible on rocks and pillars, preserving unusually direct evidence of a ruler’s ethical and political claims. His support for Buddhism connected imperial patronage with religious institutions. These texts should be read as statements of intended policy rather than proof that every subject experienced benevolent rule. Mauryan history helps compare large states whose power rested on administration, military expansion and communication across linguistically and culturally varied regions.
summary.zh: 旃陀罗笈多以华氏城为中心建立大国，后继者将权力扩展至次大陆大片地区。阿育王刻在岩石与石柱上的敕令，直接保存了君主的伦理和政治主张；其对佛教的支持，也连接皇权与宗教机构。铭文呈现的是政策宣言，不能简单等同于所有臣民的实际经历。孔雀王朝适合用于比较跨语言、跨文化帝国的战争、行政与沟通方式。

dateNote.en: Approximate 321–185 BCE follows the source’s body text; its title gives c. 323 BCE. Ancient chronology varies by a few years.
dateNote.zh: 约前321—185年依据来源正文，标题写约前323年；古代年表存在数年差异。

sources.title: Mauryan Empire (ca. 323–185 B.C.)
sources.evidenceNote: Approximate 321–185 BCE follows the source’s body text; its title gives c. 323 BCE. Ancient chronology varies by a few years.

title.en: Ptolemaic Egypt: a Mediterranean kingdom
title.zh: 托勒密埃及：地中海王国

summary.en: After Alexander’s conquests and death, Ptolemy established a ruling house in Egypt. Alexandria became a major political and intellectual centre, drawing Greek-speaking scholars and settlers into an Egyptian landscape with much older institutions. The dynasty used both Greek and Egyptian forms of kingship, while temples and new urban foundations expressed these overlapping traditions. This was not a simple replacement of one culture by another. It was a society shaped by unequal power, migration and adaptation. The kingdom’s final confrontation with Rome ended dynastic independence, but Alexandria continued as a major Mediterranean city.
summary.zh: 亚历山大征服并去世后，托勒密在埃及建立统治家族。亚历山大城成为政治与学术中心，希腊语学者和移民进入拥有更古老制度的埃及社会。王朝同时使用希腊与埃及王权形式，神庙与新城市表达这些交叠传统。这并非一种文化简单取代另一种，而是由不平等权力、迁徙与适应塑造的社会。罗马结束王国独立后，亚历山大城仍是地中海重要城市。

dateNote.en: 305–30 BCE is the royal-dynasty frame; Ptolemy governed Egypt from 323 BCE before taking the royal title.
dateNote.zh: 前305—30年指正式王朝；托勒密自前323年已治理埃及，后来才称王。

sources.title: Ptolemaic Period
sources.publisher: Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities
sources.evidenceNote: Ministry account supports Alexander’s death in 323 BCE and Ptolemy’s subsequent rule of Egypt.

sources.title: Egypt in the Ptolemaic Period
sources.evidenceNote: Essay explicitly distinguishes Alexander’s conquest in 332 BCE from the dynasty’s 305 BCE beginning and 30 BCE end; supports Alexandria, Greek/Egyptian kingship, temples and social hierarchy.

title.en: Meroë: a Kushite royal centre
title.zh: 麦罗埃：库施王国的中心

summary.en: Meroë was a royal centre of Kush in the middle Nile region. Pyramids, temples, industrial remains and water reservoirs record a society with its own political and artistic traditions. Trade and production connected this landscape with other African regions and the Mediterranean. The surviving monuments show interaction without making Kush simply an extension of Egypt.
summary.zh: 麦罗埃是尼罗河中游库施王国的王室中心。金字塔、神庙、生产遗迹与蓄水设施记录了当地自身的政治和艺术传统。贸易与生产把这里同非洲其他地区及地中海相连。这些交流痕迹并不意味着库施只是埃及的延伸。

dateNote.en: Approximate focus on Meroë's royal burial and urban phase from the third century BCE to fourth century CE. Kush's earlier history is outside this entry.
dateNote.zh: 本条目大致关注公元前三世纪至公元四世纪麦罗埃的王室墓葬与城市阶段。库施更早的历史不在此时间范围内。

sources.title: Archaeological Sites of the Island of Meroe

title.en: Parthia: between Rome and Central Asia
title.zh: 安息：罗马与中亚之间

summary.en: Arsacid rulers built a political order across Iran and Mesopotamia that linked Hellenistic inheritances with older Near Eastern traditions. Their empire stood between Roman territories and Central Asian networks, making diplomacy, warfare and exchange central to its history. Coins and monuments show rulers choosing among different visual languages rather than simply copying one predecessor. Political authority was distributed among royal and regional elites, and its strength varied. Parthia’s replacement by the Sasanians changed the ruling dynasty, but many communities and patterns of interaction persisted. It offers a useful counterpart to narratives centred only on Rome.
summary.zh: 阿尔萨息诸王在伊朗与美索不达米亚建立政治秩序，将希腊化遗产与更早的近东传统结合。帝国处于罗马领地与中亚网络之间，外交、战争和交换因此格外重要。钱币与纪念物显示统治者使用多种视觉语言，而非简单模仿前朝。权力分布于王室与地方精英之间；萨珊取代安息后，许多社区与交流方式仍然延续。

dateNote.en: 247 BCE–224 CE follows the source’s dynastic convention. The pin is a northeastern origin-region reference, not a fixed capital for all centuries.
dateNote.zh: 前247—公元224年采用来源王朝年表；标记为东北部起源地区参照，并非整个时期的固定都城。

sources.title: The Parthian Empire (247 B.C.–224 A.D.)
sources.evidenceNote: 247 BCE–224 CE follows the source’s dynastic convention. The pin is a northeastern origin-region reference, not a fixed capital for all centuries.

sources.title: Parthian Fortresses of Nisa
sources.evidenceNote: Supports Nisa as an early important Parthian city and the empire’s connections with Hellenistic and Roman worlds; pin is approximate.

title.en: Qin: building an imperial afterlife
title.zh: 秦：建造帝国的地下世界

summary.en: The first Qin emperor’s burial complex combined a large mound, planned enclosures and pits containing terracotta soldiers, horses and other objects. Construction began before the unification of China in 221 BCE. The surviving figures and weapons are evidence of military organisation and specialised production, while the overall layout echoes an imperial capital. A burial monument can therefore be read as evidence about the labour, authority and ambitions of the living.
summary.zh: 秦始皇陵把巨大封土、规划整齐的围墙和兵马俑等陪葬坑组合成地下世界。工程在公元前221年统一之前已经开始。陶俑与兵器反映军事组织和专业化制作，整体布局则呼应帝国都城。观察一座陵墓，也能了解生者社会中的劳动组织、权力和愿望。

dateNote.en: Selected construction window: work began in 246 BCE and continued through the emperor’s death in 210 BCE; this does not assert that every part was completed then.
dateNote.zh: 选取公元前246年开工至公元前210年皇帝去世的施工阶段；不表示所有工程都在这一年完成。

sources.title: Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor
sources.evidenceNote: Synthesis gives start in 246 BCE, work through death in 210 BCE, and unification in 221 BCE.

title.en: Qin: unification and its human cost
title.zh: 秦：统一及其社会代价

summary.en: Qin conquered the remaining rival states and created an imperial government claiming authority over a unified realm. Standardization of writing, weights and measures helped officials administer distant communities, while roads and large construction projects connected the new political order. The dynasty depended on military force and demanding labor obligations. Its collapse soon after the First Emperor’s death shows that administrative ambition did not guarantee durable consent. Later dynasties retained important imperial institutions even as they condemned aspects of Qin rule. The mausoleum nearby offers one material view of this concentration of resources.
summary.zh: 秦灭六国，建立统辖统一帝国的政治制度。文字、度量衡等标准化措施帮助官员治理远方社会，道路和大型工程连接新的国家秩序。军事实力与繁重劳役也是其基础。始皇去世后王朝迅速崩溃，说明行政组织能力并不等同于持久认同。后世一面批评秦政，一面继承若干帝国制度；陵墓则留下资源高度集中的物质见证。

dateNote.en: 221–206 BCE covers the imperial dynasty, not the much earlier Qin state. Xianyang is a capital reference, not a territorial centre.
dateNote.zh: 前221—206年指秦帝国，并非更早的秦国；咸阳为都城参照点。

sources.title: China, 1000 B.C.–1 A.D.
sources.evidenceNote: 221–206 BCE covers the imperial dynasty, not the much earlier Qin state. Xianyang is a capital reference, not a territorial centre.

title.en: Han: an enduring model of empire
title.zh: 汉：延续深远的帝国模式

summary.en: Han rulers rebuilt imperial power after Qin’s fall, developing a bureaucracy and a political culture shaped by classical learning. Chang’an became a major capital, while diplomacy and military campaigns linked the court with Central Asia. Sima Qian’s historical writing helped establish models for later dynastic histories. Elite tombs preserve household models, entertainment and beliefs about the afterlife, revealing social worlds beyond government alone. Han rule was interrupted by the Xin dynasty and later restored from Luoyang. Its institutional legacy lasted much longer than any stable set of imperial borders.
summary.zh: 汉在秦亡后重建帝国，以官僚制度和经典学问塑造政治文化。长安成为大都会，外交与战争又将朝廷和中亚联系起来。司马迁的著述为后世史书提供重要范式。墓葬中的住宅、乐舞和来世形象，还展现了政治之外的社会生活。汉的统治曾被新朝打断，后来以洛阳为都城恢复；制度影响远比某一时刻的疆界持久。

dateNote.en: Dynastic frame 206 BCE–220 CE includes the 9–25 CE interruption; Western Han and Eastern Han had different capitals.
dateNote.zh: 前206—公元220年的王朝框架包含公元9—25年的中断；西汉与东汉都城不同。

sources.title: Han Dynasty (206 B.C.–220 A.D.)
sources.evidenceNote: Dynastic frame 206 BCE–220 CE includes the 9–25 CE interruption; Western Han and Eastern Han had different capitals.

title.en: Sanchi: building a Buddhist sanctuary
title.zh: 桑吉：营造佛教圣地

summary.en: Sanchi brings together stupas, pillars, temples and monasteries on a hill above the surrounding plain. Much of the surviving monument group dates to the second and first centuries BCE, while the site remained an important Buddhist centre for many later centuries. Its buildings show how a place of worship could accumulate additions over time. The selected interval describes this long religious landscape rather than a single construction campaign.
summary.zh: 桑吉在山丘上汇集了佛塔、石柱、庙宇和寺院。现存古迹中许多可追溯到公元前2—1世纪，此后这里仍长期是佛教中心。建筑群显示，宗教场所可以在一代代人的使用和营造中不断增添内容。这里的时间区间表示长期形成的宗教景观，而不是一次施工工程。

dateNote.en: Broad interval from the 2nd century BCE to the 12th century CE; earlier origins and individual building dates are outside this entry’s scope.
dateNote.zh: 采用公元前2世纪至公元12世纪的宽泛区间；更早起源和单体建筑年代不在本条目范围内。

sources.title: Buddhist Monuments at Sanchi
sources.evidenceNote: Description dates most monuments to 2nd–1st centuries BCE and identifies a major Buddhist centre until the 12th century.

title.en: Silk Roads: the Chang’an–Tianshan corridor
title.zh: 丝绸之路：长安—天山廊道

location.label: Chang’an / present Xi’an; one anchor of a long corridor

summary.en: This corridor linked Chinese capitals with trading settlements and routes reaching Central Asia. It carried more than goods: religious ideas, scientific knowledge, techniques and artistic practices also travelled through its connected communities. The surviving evidence includes cities, cave temples, passes, towers and posthouses. The map marker represents an eastern anchor of a changing network; it should not be read as the origin of every exchange or as a single fixed road.
summary.zh: 这一廊道把中国都城与通向中亚的商贸聚落和道路连接起来。流动的不只是货物，还有信仰、知识、技术和艺术。城市、石窟寺、关隘、烽燧与驿站留下了不同类型的证据。地图上的标记只是不断变化的路网东端之一，不代表所有交流的起点，也不表示丝路是一条固定道路。

dateNote.en: The corridor took shape between the 2nd century BCE and 1st century CE and remained in use into the 16th century. The start is a broad century bound.
dateNote.zh: 廊道于公元前2世纪至公元1世纪间形成，并持续使用至16世纪；起始值为世纪范围的显示边界。

sources.title: Silk Roads: the Routes Network of Chang’an–Tianshan Corridor
sources.evidenceNote: Description gives formation between 2nd century BCE and 1st CE, use until 16th CE, and multiple forms of exchange.

title.en: Rome: governing through a city
title.zh: 罗马：城市与帝国治理

summary.en: Rome's imperial history can be explored through public buildings, forums, water systems and monuments. These spaces connected government, religion and everyday urban activity. As imperial authority changed, political centres also shifted. Rome remained a living city after western imperial government ended; its buildings were reused and transformed rather than history stopping at a single date.
summary.zh: 罗马帝国时期的历史可以从公共建筑、广场、供水系统与纪念物中展开。这些空间把治理、宗教和城市日常活动联系起来。随着帝国权力改变，政治中心也发生转移。西部帝国统治结束后，罗马仍有人生活，旧建筑被继续使用与改造，历史并未在某一年停止。

dateNote.en: Conventional western imperial frame, 27 BCE–476 CE. The Eastern Roman Empire continued; this interval must not be treated as the whole Roman world's lifespan.
dateNote.zh: 采用公元前27年至公元476年的常见西部帝国分期。东罗马帝国继续存在，因此不能把这一范围视为整个罗马世界的起止。

title.en: Aksum: connections across the Red Sea
title.zh: 阿克苏姆：跨越红海的联系

summary.en: Aksum stood within trade networks linking northeast Africa, Arabia and the Mediterranean world. Its rulers drew on routes through the port of Adulis, while monumental stone stelae and inscriptions expressed royal authority. Inscriptions in different languages preserve evidence of these connections, and the city's later religious importance outlasted its ancient political power.
summary.zh: 阿克苏姆位于连接非洲东北部、阿拉伯半岛与地中海世界的贸易网络中。统治者依托通往阿杜利斯港的路线，石碑与铭文则展示王权。不同语言的铭文保存了交流的证据，而这座城市后来的宗教地位延续到了古代政权衰落之后。

dateNote.en: Approximate first-to-eighth-century focus following UNESCO's kingdom summary. The city's monuments and religious history span a longer period.
dateNote.zh: 依据联合国教科文组织对王国的概述，大致选取公元一至八世纪。城市建筑与宗教历史的时间跨度更长。

title.en: Hopewell: earthworks and long-distance gathering
title.zh: 霍普维尔：土筑工程与远距离集会

location.label: Hopewell Mound Group, Ohio River watershed

summary.en: Indigenous communities in the Ohio River watershed created enormous geometric earthworks for ceremonial gatherings and the treatment of the dead. Circles, squares and other forms required shared measurements and coordinated labor, while some alignments followed solar and lunar cycles. Objects made from materials reaching Ohio from distant regions reveal connections extending toward Florida and the Yellowstone basin. These were networks of communities rather than evidence of one centrally ruled empire. “Hopewell” is a modern archaeological label, taken from a later landowner’s name. The earthworks preserve Indigenous achievements in engineering, astronomy, art and collective organization that preceded European arrival by many centuries.
summary.zh: 俄亥俄河流域的原住民社区营建巨大的几何土筑设施，用于仪式集会和安葬。圆形、方形等结构需要共同尺度与协调劳动，部分布局与日月周期相应。远方材料制成的器物显示，联系延伸至佛罗里达和黄石流域。这些证据反映社区网络，而非一个中央集权帝国。“霍普维尔”是现代考古名称，来自后来地主的姓氏，并非已知古代自称。土筑遗存记录原住民在欧洲人到来数百年前的工程、天文、艺术与集体组织成就。

dateNote.en: 1–400 CE follows the National Park Service’s focus on the local ceremonial florescence. It does not encompass the entire Middle Woodland period or every tradition classified as Hopewell.
dateNote.zh: 公元1—400年采用美国国家公园管理局对当地仪式文化兴盛阶段的分期，不涵盖整个中林地时期或所有被归为霍普维尔的传统。

sources.evidenceNote: Describes ceremonial and mortuary gatherings, earthen enclosures, crafted objects and a local florescence in 1–400 CE. Also explains that Hopewell is a modern archaeological name derived from a later landowner, not a documented ancient self-designation.

sources.evidenceNote: Supports geometric construction and long-distance connections reaching the Yellowstone basin and Florida. The narrative avoids calling the cultural network one centralized state.

title.en: Kushan: a crossroads of religions and trade
title.zh: 贵霜：宗教与贸易的交汇

summary.en: Kushan rulers connected parts of Central Asia, Afghanistan and northern South Asia. Their territories participated in both caravan commerce and maritime exchange, while coins and religious images reveal a meeting of different languages and traditions. Buddhism flourished alongside other forms of worship. Peshawar and Mathura were important centres, and artistic workshops developed influential ways of depicting sacred figures. The kingdom’s chronology remains debated, so this atlas uses a broad period of consolidation and prominence. Its history is especially useful for seeing how political territories and cultural networks can overlap without matching exactly.
summary.zh: 贵霜连接中亚、阿富汗与南亚北部，既参与商队贸易，也联系海上交换。钱币和宗教图像呈现多种语言与传统相遇；佛教兴盛，同时并存其他信仰。白沙瓦与马图拉是重要中心，工坊发展出影响深远的神圣人物形象。贵霜年代仍有争论，此处采用巩固与兴盛的大致阶段，帮助理解政治领土与文化网络相交却并不完全重合。

dateNote.en: 1–300 CE is a rounded focus on imperial consolidation and flourishing, not exact founding and extinction dates; Kushan chronology is disputed.
dateNote.zh: 公元1—300年为帝国巩固和兴盛的取整关注时段，并非精确建国与灭亡年；贵霜年代仍有争议。

sources.title: Kushan Empire (ca. Second Century B.C.–Third Century A.D.)
sources.evidenceNote: 1–300 CE is a rounded focus on imperial consolidation and flourishing, not exact founding and extinction dates; Kushan chronology is disputed.

title.en: Teotihuacan: planning a large city
title.zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎：大型城市的规划

summary.en: Teotihuacan grew into a large Mesoamerican city organized around a major avenue and monumental complexes. Its builders integrated the valley's landscape into a geometric urban plan, including changes to the river's course. The city's art and architecture influenced other regions, showing that urban influence could travel beyond the people living inside a city.
summary.zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎发展为中部美洲的大型城市，以主要大道和大型建筑群组织空间。建造者把河谷地形纳入几何规划，还改变了河流的走向。城市的艺术与建筑影响了其他地区，表明城市影响力能够超越居民实际生活的范围。

dateNote.en: Approximate first-to-seventh-century urban development range used by UNESCO. Earlier occupation and later reuse are outside this focus.
dateNote.zh: 采用联合国教科文组织所列约公元一至七世纪的城市发展阶段，更早的居住与后来的再利用不在本条目重点内。

title.en: Sasanian Iran: kingship and imperial rivalry
title.zh: 萨珊伊朗：王权与帝国竞争

summary.en: Ardashir’s defeat of the Parthians founded a new dynasty that claimed links to earlier Persian kings. Sasanian rulers developed coinage, monumental royal imagery and strong associations with Zoroastrian institutions. Their wars with Rome and Byzantium repeatedly reshaped western frontiers, while eastern rivals also affected imperial fortunes. Silver vessels and textiles carried royal and courtly imagery far beyond the empire. Its artistic influence therefore outlasted its political power. The seventh-century conquests ended the dynasty, but Iranian traditions contributed to the Islamic societies that followed rather than disappearing with the last Sasanian king.
summary.zh: 阿尔达希尔击败安息后建立新王朝，并追认更早波斯王权传统。萨珊发展钱币与宏大王室图像，与祆教机构关系密切。同罗马及拜占庭的战争不断改变西部边界，东方对手也影响国运。银器和织物将宫廷图像传播至帝国之外，艺术影响超过政治寿命。七世纪征服结束王朝，但伊朗传统继续参与塑造后来的伊斯兰社会。

dateNote.en: 224–651 CE is the conventional Sasanian span. Ctesiphon is a capital marker; military frontiers changed repeatedly.
dateNote.zh: 224—651年为通常采用的萨珊时段；泰西封为都城标记，军事边界不断变化。

sources.title: The Sasanian Empire (224–651 A.D.)
sources.evidenceNote: 224–651 CE is the conventional Sasanian span. Ctesiphon is a capital marker; military frontiers changed repeatedly.

title.en: Mogao: art at a crossroads
title.zh: 莫高窟：交汇之地的艺术

summary.en: Mogao’s cave sanctuaries sit near routes used by merchants, pilgrims and travellers. Their wall paintings and sculptures preserve successive layers of Buddhist art and show connections with artistic traditions elsewhere in Asia. The caves were made and renewed across many generations, rather than as one project. Comparing their images turns a map of trade routes into a question about how beliefs, techniques and visual ideas moved between communities.
summary.zh: 莫高窟靠近商人、朝圣者和旅行者往来的道路。壁画与雕塑保留了不同阶段的佛教艺术，也呈现与亚洲其他地区艺术传统的联系。这些洞窟经过许多代人的建造与修缮，并非一次完成。比较其中的图像，可以进一步思考信仰、技艺与视觉表达如何随人员往来而传播。

dateNote.en: Broad century interval: 4th–14th centuries CE. The interval describes the artistic sequence, not exact opening and closing dates.
dateNote.zh: 采用公元4—14世纪的宽泛区间，表示艺术发展的阶段，而非精确的开创与终止年份。

sources.evidenceNote: UNESCO identifies the Silk Route crossroads and approximately one millennium of Buddhist art.

title.en: Gupta: courts, temples and classical forms
title.zh: 笈多：宫廷、寺院与古典形式

summary.en: The Gupta dynasty brought several northern Indian political centres under one ruling house. During this broad period, Hindu temple forms and sacred imagery developed alongside flourishing Buddhist institutions. Artistic production was supported by courts and other patrons rather than a single uniform religious program. The period is often presented as a “golden age,” but that label can hide differences of region, status and experience. Looking at architecture, sculpture and surviving texts allows a more specific inquiry into what changed. Gupta political authority eventually fragmented, while many artistic and intellectual forms continued in new settings.
summary.zh: 笈多王朝将北印度若干政治中心置于同一统治家族之下。这一时期，印度教寺庙和神像形式发展，佛教机构也持续繁荣。艺术由宫廷及多种赞助者支持，并非单一宗教规划。笈多常被称作“黄金时代”，但这一说法容易遮蔽地域、身份与生活经历的差异。考察建筑、雕塑和文献，可以更具体地认识变化；王权解体后，许多文化形式仍继续发展。

dateNote.en: c. 321–500 CE follows the Met’s northern political-control interval. Gupta successors and cultural forms continued afterward; this is not a final extinction date.
dateNote.zh: 约321—500年采用大都会博物馆所列北印度政治控制时段；后继政权与文化形式其后延续，这并非最终消亡日期。

sources.title: South Asia, 1–500 A.D.
sources.evidenceNote: Chronology explicitly gives northern Gupta control c.321–c.500; overview and events support religious and artistic development. Dates are a political focus, not the entire cultural period.

title.en: Eastern Roman Empire: continuity and change
title.zh: 东罗马帝国：延续与变化

summary.en: The empire centred on Constantinople continued Roman political traditions while its language, institutions, territories and religious culture changed. Art and architecture connected courts, churches and urban communities. The conquest of Constantinople in 1204 fragmented imperial authority; rulers based elsewhere sustained successor states before the city's recovery in 1261. The history therefore contains interruptions within its long conventional date range.
summary.zh: 以君士坦丁堡为中心的帝国延续了罗马政治传统，同时语言、制度、领土与宗教文化不断改变。艺术和建筑连接着宫廷、教会与城市社群。1204年君士坦丁堡被攻占，帝国权威分裂；其他地方的统治者维持继承政权，直到1261年收复城市。因此，漫长分期之中也包含中断。

dateNote.en: Conventional 330–1453 frame. Constantinople was under Latin rule in 1204–1261; successor states and regional continuities make this more complex than one uninterrupted polity.
dateNote.zh: 采用330至1453年的常见分期。1204至1261年君士坦丁堡受拉丁政权控制，继承国家与地区延续使历史比单一政权的连续存续更复杂。

title.en: Nalanda: learning in a monastic community
title.zh: 那烂陀：寺院社区中的学习

summary.en: Nalanda combined places for study, residence and religious practice. Its surviving monasteries, shrines, stupas and artworks record a long association between the transmission of knowledge and Buddhist institutions. The main scholastic establishment developed from the fifth century CE and continued into the thirteenth. The site helps distinguish the history of an institution from the history of its buildings: archaeological remains can predate the educational phase highlighted here.
summary.zh: 那烂陀把学习、居住与宗教实践的场所结合在一起。寺院、祠堂、佛塔和艺术品记录了知识传授与佛教机构之间的长期联系。这里重点呈现公元5—13世纪的教学机构。考古遗迹有些早于这一阶段，因此应区分一个机构的历史与整片遗址的历史。

dateNote.en: 5th–13th centuries CE covers the scholastic phase in UNESCO’s synthesis; the site also contains earlier remains.
dateNote.zh: 公元5—13世纪对应来源综述中的教学机构阶段；遗址另有更早遗存。

sources.title: Archaeological Site of Nalanda Mahavihara at Nalanda, Bihar
sources.evidenceNote: Synthesis distinguishes c. 3rd-century BCE remains from the 5th–13th-century monastic-scholastic establishment.

title.en: Tiwanaku: sacred authority and highland agriculture
title.zh: 蒂瓦纳科：神圣权威与高原农业

summary.en: Near Lake Titicaca, Tiwanaku became a major centre of political and religious authority in the southern Andes. Carefully worked stone, monumental platforms and sunken courts organized collective ceremonial life. The Akapana complex and other buildings included sophisticated drainage, while raised agricultural fields helped communities farm the demanding highland environment. Images of powerful beings circulated across different materials and connected the centre with more distant valleys and coastal communities. Tiwanaku and Wari shared some visual traditions but were distinct societies. The surviving ceremonial core therefore offers evidence of both local engineering and wider relationships, without defining a single unchanging imperial boundary.
summary.zh: 在的的喀喀湖附近，蒂瓦纳科发展为南安第斯重要的政治与宗教中心。精加工石材、宏伟平台和下沉庭院组织集体仪式生活。阿卡帕纳建筑群等设施配有复杂排水系统，垄田技术则帮助社区适应严酷高原环境。神灵图像在多种材料上流传，将中心与远方山谷和海岸社会联系起来。蒂瓦纳科与瓦里共享部分视觉传统，却属于不同社会；现存仪式核心展示地方工程技术及广泛关系，而不能界定一个始终不变的帝国疆界。

dateNote.en: 500–900 CE is UNESCO’s stated apogee, selected for comparison with contemporary Andean societies. Settlement began earlier, and political decline and cultural continuity extended beyond 900.
dateNote.zh: 500—900年为联合国教科文组织所列鼎盛阶段，便于与同时期安第斯社会比较；聚落更早出现，政治衰落与文化延续也超出900年。

sources.title: Tiwanaku: Spiritual and Political Centre of the Tiwanaku Culture
sources.evidenceNote: Supports the selected 500–900 CE apogee, Lake Titicaca setting, monumental ceremonial buildings, sophisticated drainage and raised-field agriculture. The 900 endpoint marks the chosen apogee, not abandonment or the end of the culture.

sources.title: Wari Imperial Art
sources.publisher: The Metropolitan Museum of Art; José Ochatoma Paravicino
sources.evidenceNote: Essay by a Wari-site researcher and archaeology professor supports the broad 600–1000 CE period, Ayacucho capital, D-shaped temples, Nasca and Tiwanaku interaction, ceremonial weaving and disputed causes of collapse. It explicitly treats Wari and Tiwanaku as distinct political societies.

title.en: Sui: reunification before the Tang
title.zh: 隋：唐之前的重新统一

summary.en: The Sui reunited a large part of China after centuries of competing northern and southern regimes. Although short-lived, the dynasty created the political setting inherited by the Tang. Its story is useful for understanding how periods labeled “division” could end through conquest and reorganization rather than the sudden disappearance of regional differences. The capital around modern Xi’an connected older imperial traditions with a new ruling house. Compare this brief reunification with the much longer Tang period to see why a dynasty’s duration and its institutional importance need not be the same.
summary.zh: 隋结束长期南北分立，重新统一中国的大部分地区。王朝虽短，却为唐建立了重要的政治基础。它提示我们，所谓“分裂时代”的结束往往来自征服和制度重组，并不意味着区域差异立即消失。今西安附近的都城连接旧有帝国传统与新王朝。将隋与长期延续的唐对照，可以看见统治年数与制度影响并不总成正比。

dateNote.en: 581–618 follows the Met chronology; the Sui completed reunification in 589. This entry marks a political transition, not a uniform cultural period.
dateNote.zh: 581—618年采用大都会博物馆年表；隋于589年完成统一。此处关注政治转折，而非假定文化始终一致。

sources.title: China, 500–1000 A.D.
sources.evidenceNote: Chronology gives Sui 581–618, conquest/reunification by 589, the capital at Chang’an and the transition to Tang in 618.

title.en: Chichén Itzá: a Maya city with wide connections
title.zh: 奇琴伊察：联系广泛的玛雅城市

summary.en: Chichén Itzá brought rulers, builders, farmers, craftspeople and religious specialists together in one of northern Yucatán’s major urban centres. Paved causeways linked important spaces, while platforms supported imposing temples, columned halls and the Great Ball Court. El Castillo and El Caracol show how architecture expressed religious and celestial concerns. Buildings combine Maya forms with features also found in central Mexico, evidence of sustained interaction whose political mechanisms remain debated. The city belongs to a changing Maya world, not a civilization that simply vanished when particular capitals declined. Its monuments reveal both local traditions and connections extending beyond the peninsula.
summary.zh: 奇琴伊察是尤卡坦北部重要城市，聚集统治者、建筑工匠、农民、手工业者与宗教人员。石铺堤道连接重要空间，平台承托宏伟神庙、柱厅和大球场。库库尔坎金字塔与“蜗牛”建筑体现宗教及天象关怀。建筑结合玛雅形式和墨西哥中部也有的特征，显示持续交往，但背后的政治机制仍有争论。城市属于不断变化的玛雅世界；个别都城衰落并不意味着玛雅文明或人民消失。遗迹同时保存地方传统与半岛以外的广泛联系。

dateNote.en: c.600–1200 CE is the broad urban flourishing window in INAH’s site account, not exact foundation or abandonment dates. The chronology of particular buildings and political transitions is more complex.
dateNote.zh: 约600—1200年采用墨西哥国家人类学与历史研究所所列城市兴盛窗口，并非精确建城或废弃年；各建筑和政治转变的年代更复杂。

sources.title: Chichén Itzá
sources.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Antropología e Historia, Mexico
sources.evidenceNote: INAH gives a broad heyday around 600–1200 CE and describes paved sacbeob, the main ceremonial platform, buildings and relations with central Mexican architectural traditions. This is a selected focus window, not exact foundation or abandonment.

sources.title: Pre-Hispanic City of Chichen-Itza
sources.evidenceNote: Supports Chichén Itzá as a major Maya centre, architectural interaction with central Mexico, and the Temple of the Warriors, El Castillo and El Caracol. The record does not equate stylistic similarity with proven conquest.

title.en: Wari: an Andean imperial world before the Inca
title.zh: 瓦里：印加之前的安第斯帝国世界

summary.en: From the Ayacucho highlands, Wari developed an expansive political order centuries before the Inca. Its capital used stone and earthen construction, painted walls and distinctive D-shaped temples to organize urban and ceremonial spaces. Artists adapted ideas from the Nasca coast and from Tiwanaku, producing an imperial visual language without erasing those separate societies. Expert weavers made richly patterned garments used in ritual and elite display; ceramics carried sacred figures, animals and plants. The capital’s eventual abandonment followed a crisis whose causes remain debated. Wari history shows how religious imagery, skilled production and political expansion could reinforce one another.
summary.zh: 瓦里从阿亚库乔高地发展为扩张性政治体系，比印加早数百年。都城以石构、土筑、彩绘墙面及独特的D形神庙组织城市与仪式空间。艺术家吸收纳斯卡海岸和蒂瓦纳科的观念，创造帝国视觉语言，但这些社会并未因此成为同一政权。织工制作纹样复杂的礼仪及精英服装，陶器描绘神圣人物、动物和植物。都城最终在危机中废弃，具体原因仍有争论。瓦里历史显示宗教图像、专业生产和政治扩张如何相互支持。

dateNote.en: Approximately 600–1000 CE follows the Met’s broad Wari imperial-art chronology. Individual centres changed at different times; the date does not imply a simultaneous collapse throughout the Andes.
dateNote.zh: 约600—1000年采用大都会博物馆的瓦里帝国艺术宽泛分期；各中心变化时间不同，并非整个安第斯同时崩溃。

sources.title: Wari Imperial Art
sources.publisher: The Metropolitan Museum of Art; José Ochatoma Paravicino
sources.evidenceNote: Essay by a Wari-site researcher and archaeology professor supports the broad 600–1000 CE period, Ayacucho capital, D-shaped temples, Nasca and Tiwanaku interaction, ceremonial weaving and disputed causes of collapse. It explicitly treats Wari and Tiwanaku as distinct political societies.

title.en: Gyeongju: Buddhist art in a royal landscape
title.zh: 庆州：王都景观中的佛教艺术

summary.en: Gyeongju preserves temples, palaces, pagodas, reliefs and sculptures associated with the Silla capital. The concentration of Buddhist art shows how religious expression became part of an urban and royal landscape. Looking across several sites reveals different forms of patronage and craftsmanship rather than one isolated monument. This selected period focuses on the seventh to tenth centuries, when the surviving artistic tradition represented here was particularly active.
summary.zh: 庆州保留了与新罗都城有关的寺庙、宫殿、佛塔、浮雕和造像。集中的佛教艺术展示了宗教表达如何成为城市与王都景观的一部分。把多个遗址联系起来，可以观察不同形式的营造和工艺，而不只关注一座孤立的古迹。这里选取7—10世纪的艺术发展阶段。

dateNote.en: 7th–10th centuries CE is the source’s artistic focus; it is not the complete chronology of Silla or of Korean Buddhism.
dateNote.zh: 公元7—10世纪是来源强调的艺术阶段，并非新罗或朝鲜半岛佛教的完整年代。

sources.title: Gyeongju Historic Areas
sources.evidenceNote: Description emphasises Buddhist art from the 7th–10th centuries; synthesis identifies the Silla capital landscape.

title.en: Early Islam: a community takes shape
title.zh: 早期伊斯兰：共同体的形成

summary.en: Muslim tradition dates Muhammad’s first revelations to 610 in Mecca. Opposition there was followed by migration to Medina, where a new religious and political community developed. The revelations later collected in the Qur’an became central to Muslim belief and practice. The Hijra became the starting point for the Islamic calendar, showing how communities organize time around formative events. This entry concerns the beginnings of Islam in western Arabia rather than the full later history of Muslim societies. Subsequent conquests, conversions and intellectual traditions unfolded over centuries across many different regions.
summary.zh: 伊斯兰传统将穆罕默德在麦加最初受启示的时间定于610年。面对反对，他和追随者迁往麦地那，形成新的宗教与政治共同体。后来汇编为《古兰经》的启示成为信仰和实践的核心。迁徙被用作伊斯兰历纪元，显示共同体如何以关键事件组织时间。本条目关注阿拉伯西部的早期阶段，此后征服、传播和思想传统跨越多个世纪与地区。

dateNote.en: 610–632 covers Muhammad’s prophetic career in traditional chronology; 622 is the Hijra. Religious beliefs are attributed as beliefs.
dateNote.zh: 610—632年为传统年表中的传教生涯，622年为希吉拉迁徙；宗教信念按其传统表述。

sources.title: The Birth of Islam
sources.evidenceNote: 610–632 covers Muhammad’s prophetic career in traditional chronology; 622 is the Hijra. Religious beliefs are attributed as beliefs.

title.en: Tang: a cosmopolitan imperial world
title.zh: 唐：多元交流的帝国世界

summary.en: Tang Chang’an was a meeting place for diplomats, merchants, monks and artists from across Eurasia. Imperial patronage supported poetry, painting and religious institutions, while imported fashions and objects reveal the movement of people and ideas. The court’s reach changed considerably over time. The An Lushan rebellion weakened central authority, yet Tang rule and cultural production continued for generations. This is a history of both exchange and conflict: the same networks that carried valued goods also operated within rivalries, military campaigns and changing relationships between the capital and regional powers.
summary.zh: 唐长安汇聚欧亚各地使节、商人、僧侣与艺术家。皇室支持诗歌、绘画和宗教事业，外来服饰与器物又见证人员与观念流动。朝廷的影响范围并非一成不变；安史之乱削弱中央权威，但唐的统治与文化创造仍延续多代。这既是交流史，也是冲突史：商品和思想的网络始终处于战争、竞争及中央与地方关系的变化之中。

dateNote.en: 618–907 is the dynastic span. The source URL retains an older “906” slug, but its visible title and text use 907.
dateNote.zh: 王朝时段为618—907年。来源网址保留旧的“906”字样，但现行标题采用907年。

sources.title: Tang Dynasty (618–907)
sources.evidenceNote: 618–907 is the dynastic span. The source URL retains an older “906” slug, but its visible title and text use 907.

title.en: Srivijaya: power across maritime connections
title.zh: 室利佛逝：海上联系中的权力

summary.en: Srivijaya developed as a major Buddhist and maritime power associated with Sumatra and connections across the seas of Southeast Asia. Palembang and Jambi were important centres in its changing history. Authority depended on relationships among ports, rulers and routes rather than on a single continuously controlled landmass. Religious networks and commercial exchange connected the region with wider Asian worlds. By the later thirteenth century, competing powers were reshaping these relationships. The story is partly reconstructed from inscriptions and outside accounts, so sweeping claims about fixed imperial borders should be treated more cautiously than evidence for particular places and contacts.
summary.zh: 室利佛逝成为以苏门答腊为重要基地的佛教与海上强权，巨港和占碑在不同时期发挥关键作用。其权力依赖港口、统治者与航路之间的关系，并非始终控制一整片连续陆地。宗教网络和商业交流把东南亚连接到更广的亚洲。至十三世纪后期，竞争势力重塑这些联系。历史部分依赖铭文与外来记载重建，因此固定帝国疆界的宏大主张，需要比具体地点和交往证据更谨慎地处理。

dateNote.en: 650–1300 is an approximate display interval for a polity prominent from the seventh through thirteenth centuries, not exact founding and extinction dates.
dateNote.zh: 650—1300年为七至十三世纪主要活动期的近似显示范围，并非精确建国或灭亡日期。

sources.title: Sang Nila Utama: historical background of Srivijaya
sources.evidenceNote: 650–1300 is an approximate display interval for a polity prominent from the seventh through thirteenth centuries, not exact founding and extinction dates.

sources.title: Southeast Asia, 500–1000 A.D.
sources.evidenceNote: 650–1300 is an approximate display interval for a polity prominent from the seventh through thirteenth centuries, not exact founding and extinction dates.

title.en: Umayyads: governing from Damascus
title.zh: 倭马亚：以大马士革为中心统治

summary.en: The Umayyad dynasty moved the centre of caliphal power to Syria. From Damascus, its rulers governed a rapidly expanded realm stretching at its greatest reach from the Atlantic toward the Indus. Arabic gained an official administrative role, while artists and builders adapted Byzantine, Sasanian and local traditions to new settings. Monumental religious buildings expressed the dynasty’s authority in prominent urban spaces. Expansion did not create an immediately homogeneous society: languages, religions and local practices remained varied. The Abbasid revolution ended Umayyad rule in the east, while an Umayyad branch later ruled in Iberia.
summary.zh: 倭马亚将哈里发政治中心移至叙利亚，以大马士革为都城治理迅速扩张的疆域，最广时从大西洋延至印度河方向。阿拉伯语获得官方行政地位，艺术家则改造拜占庭、萨珊与地方传统。宏伟宗教建筑在城市中展示王朝权威。扩张并未立即制造同质社会，各种语言、宗教和生活方式仍然并存；阿拔斯革命后，倭马亚支系又在伊比利亚延续。

dateNote.en: 661–750 covers the Damascus caliphate; the later Iberian Umayyads have a separate chronology.
dateNote.zh: 661—750年指大马士革哈里发国；后来的伊比利亚倭马亚政权另有年表。

sources.title: The Art of the Umayyad Period (661–750)
sources.evidenceNote: 661–750 covers the Damascus caliphate; the later Iberian Umayyads have a separate chronology.

title.en: Borobudur: a monument to move through
title.zh: 婆罗浮屠：在行进中阅读的建筑

summary.en: Borobudur’s builders arranged square terraces, circular platforms and a large upper stupa into a Buddhist monument in central Java. Reliefs and Buddha images give its architectural levels a visual language as well as a physical form. The eighth and ninth centuries frame its construction here. The monument encourages a comparison between looking at a building from outside and learning through movement, sequence and repeated images within its spaces.
summary.zh: 婆罗浮屠的建造者把方形台层、圆形平台和顶部大塔组合成爪哇中部的佛教建筑。浮雕与佛像使不同层次既有空间形式，也有视觉语言。这里以公元8—9世纪表示其营造阶段。它引出一个观察角度：从外部观看建筑，与在空间中通过行进、顺序和反复出现的图像来理解建筑，有何不同？

dateNote.en: Broad construction centuries, 8th–9th CE; not exact foundation/completion years or an end date for Buddhist practice.
dateNote.zh: 采用公元8—9世纪的营造范围；不是精确开工与竣工年份，也不是佛教实践的终止时间。

sources.title: Borobudur Temple Compounds
sources.evidenceNote: Source dates the temple to the 8th–9th centuries and describes terraces, circular platforms, reliefs and stupas.

title.en: Abbasids: Baghdad and a changing caliphate
title.zh: 阿拔斯：巴格达与变化中的哈里发国

summary.en: The Abbasids replaced the Umayyads and shifted the political centre eastward to Iraq. Baghdad, founded in 762, became a major court, commercial and cultural centre; Samarra briefly took over its capital role. Distinctive styles of decoration and new ceramic techniques circulated through the realm’s networks. The caliphate’s long formal life should not be mistaken for uninterrupted central control: regional rulers gained substantial independence. Baghdad’s fall to Mongol armies in 1258 ended this phase of Abbasid rule. Comparing the caliphate’s symbolic authority with the power of local dynasties helps explain a politically layered medieval world.
summary.zh: 阿拔斯取代倭马亚后，将政治重心东移伊拉克。762年建立的巴格达成为重要宫廷、商业与文化中心，萨迈拉曾短暂取代其都城地位。新的装饰风格与陶瓷技术通过网络流传。哈里发国名义上的长期延续，并不代表中央始终掌控各地，地方王朝逐渐独立。1258年蒙古攻陷巴格达结束这一阶段；比较象征权威与地方实权，有助于理解中世纪多层政治结构。

dateNote.en: 750–1258 refers to the Baghdad-based Abbasid era, including the Samarra interlude and centuries of reduced direct political power.
dateNote.zh: 750—1258年指以巴格达为主体的阿拔斯时期，包含萨迈拉阶段及中央实权减弱的时期。

sources.title: The Art of the Abbasid Period (750–1258)
sources.evidenceNote: 750–1258 refers to the Baghdad-based Abbasid era, including the Samarra interlude and centuries of reduced direct political power.

title.en: Heian Japan: writing a courtly world
title.zh: 平安日本：书写宫廷世界

summary.en: The imperial court moved to Heiankyō and developed a culture closely associated with aristocratic households. The Fujiwara family exercised influence through marriage and regency, while poetry, diaries and narratives gave court life lasting literary form. Kana writing made new kinds of Japanese expression possible; The Tale of Genji is a celebrated example. Buddhist practice and continental connections remained important even as distinctive local artistic forms developed. By the late twelfth century, military families were challenging courtly political dominance. The period shows that a cultural capital can remain influential while practical political power shifts elsewhere.
summary.zh: 朝廷迁往平安京后，贵族家庭塑造了宫廷文化。藤原氏通过婚姻和摄政影响政局，诗歌、日记与物语保存了宫廷生活。假名使日语书写产生新的形式，《源氏物语》即为著名例证。佛教与大陆交流依旧重要，本土艺术也逐渐发展。十二世纪后期武家力量上升，说明文化中心可以持续有影响力，而实际政治权力已向别处转移。

dateNote.en: 794 marks the move to Heiankyō; 1185 is the conventional end used in the source, associated with the victory of the Minamoto.
dateNote.zh: 794年迁都平安京；1185年为来源采用的惯例终点，与源氏胜利相关。

sources.title: Heian Period (794–1185)
sources.evidenceNote: 794 marks the move to Heiankyō; 1185 is the conventional end used in the source, associated with the victory of the Minamoto.

title.en: Cahokia: an Indigenous urban landscape
title.zh: 卡霍基亚：原住民的城市景观

summary.en: Cahokia was a large Indigenous settlement with earthen mounds, surrounding villages and agricultural communities. Monks Mound and the wider layout show the scale of organized construction in the Mississippi valley. The settlement offers evidence of the cultural, religious and economic life of Mississippian societies and the relationships between a large centre and its surrounding communities.
summary.zh: 卡霍基亚是一处大型原住民聚落，拥有土丘、周围村庄与农业社群。僧侣丘及整体布局展示了密西西比河谷组织建造的规模。这处聚落为认识密西西比文化社群的文化、宗教和经济生活，以及大型中心与周围社群的关系，提供了证据。

dateNote.en: Approximate main occupation range, 800–1400, from UNESCO. The page places the city's population peak around 1050–1150, within this longer span.
dateNote.zh: 联合国教科文组织所列主要居住时期约为800至1400年，其中城市人口高峰约在1050至1150年。

title.en: 800: Charlemagne and a new imperial claim
title.zh: 800：查理曼与新的帝国主张

summary.en: Charlemagne’s coronation as emperor in Rome linked Frankish kingship with a revived claim to Roman imperial authority in western Europe. His realm already stretched across much of the continent, held together through conquest, aristocratic relationships and cooperation with the church. The court sponsored learning, manuscripts and buildings that adapted classical and Christian models. Aachen became a particularly important centre of this political culture. The coronation did not reunite all former Roman lands: an eastern Roman emperor still ruled from Constantinople. It created another powerful language of legitimacy within a divided medieval world.
summary.zh: 查理曼在罗马加冕为皇帝，使法兰克王权与西欧复兴罗马帝权的主张相结合。他的国家已横跨欧洲大片地区，依靠征服、贵族关系与教会合作维系。宫廷支持学术、抄本和建筑，改造古典与基督教传统，亚琛成为重要中心。加冕并未统一全部罗马故地，君士坦丁堡仍有东罗马皇帝；它在分裂的中世纪世界中建立了另一套强大的合法性语言。

dateNote.en: The coronation occurred in Rome on 25 December 800; Aachen is the representative court marker.
dateNote.zh: 800年12月25日在罗马加冕；地图以主要宫廷所在地亚琛为参照。

sources.title: Carolingian Art
sources.evidenceNote: The coronation occurred in Rome on 25 December 800; Aachen is the representative court marker.

title.en: Wagadu / Ghana: wealth across the Sahara
title.zh: 瓦加杜／加纳：跨撒哈拉的财富

summary.en: The Soninke kingdom known to Arabic writers as Ghana occupied a strategic position in western Sahel trade. Gold, salt and other goods moved through networks connecting local production with Saharan caravans and Mediterranean markets. Rulers benefited from these exchanges, but traders, pastoralists and mining communities also sustained the system. Ghana was located far from the modern country that later adopted its name. Archaeology and written descriptions do not always resolve a single permanent capital. The kingdom’s changing fortunes show how shifts in routes and access to resources could alter political power without ending regional commerce.
summary.zh: 阿拉伯作者称作“加纳”的索宁克王国，位于西萨赫勒贸易要地。黄金、盐及其他物资通过地方生产、沙漠商队与地中海市场相连。统治者获利，商人、牧民与采矿社区也共同维持网络。古加纳距离后来沿用其名称的现代加纳很远；考古和文献也未必能确定唯一永久都城。商路与资源变化影响王权，但不等于区域贸易终止。

dateNote.en: 800–1100 is a selected period of prominence, not exact founding and ending dates. The pin is a debated capital-region reference.
dateNote.zh: 800—1100年为选定兴盛阶段，并非精确建国灭亡年；标记为仍有讨论的都城地区参照。

sources.title: The Trans-Saharan Gold Trade (7th–14th Century)
